description: Star: one central haplotype with three singleton satellites
derivation: Hand-traced. Center AAAA differs by 1 from each satellite (TAAA, ATAA, AATA); satellites differ by 2 from each other. The unique MST is the star on the center with three unit edges. Ids by sorted sequence: AAAA->H1? sorted(['AAAA','AATA','ATAA','TAAA']) = AAAA, AATA, ATAA, TAAA -> H1..H4; center is H1.
